text:
I can't confirm that no burning occurred, but the evidence shows no satellite-detected fire.

NASA FIRMS recorded zero thermal detections intersecting ASSET-F04 between 2026-10-04 and 2026-11-03. All four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day of that period, so the absence of detections isn't a coverage gap.

However, this doesn't rule out burning. Small, short-lived, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any land change, or anything outside this period.

A suitable wording would be: "No FIRMS thermal anomalies were detected on the property during 4 Oct–3 Nov 2026." If you need to confirm no burning at all, you'd need additional evidence, such as burned-area imagery or ground reports.
